parent_studies: ROC-02 exact source and 12 frozen original checkpoints
status: Frozen before ROC-02C model observer fitting
scope: Calibration-only rank-8 diagnostic pilot on twelve existing ROC-02 checkpoints. It does NOT replace ROC-01 Amendment C's full nine-rank prospective ROC-02 stage; no sealed test evaluation or rank selection.

data.time: h after half post-input thinking rounds

observer.initialization: ROC-02B train-only supervised rank-8 U with deterministic SVD and QR
observer.ridge: closed form train-only centered eight-output linear ridge, alpha 1
observer.train_loss: mean squared eight-way one-hot label error after refitted ridge
observer.optimizer: Adam float64 raw 128x8 basis, QR orthogonalization each step
observer.optimizer_initialization: clone same initial U for every arm

leakage: b(h,U)=||U^T(T-I)(I-UU^T)||F/||T-I||F at two calibration shadow states
null_reference: fixed per-state, per-checkpoint, k8 medians from the original published 128 null bases (ROC-02B), unaltered by optimization
penalty: gamma * mean_{two dev shadow states} (b(h,U)/median_null_b(h,k8))^2; fixed per-state denominator
evaluation: Dev-only task MSE and accuracy, B/null ratio, s=trace(U^T H U)/tr H, original model calibration accuracy, absolute B/√k and projector distance
selection: Using calibration only, choose lowest J_dev=E_dev+mean (b/m_b)^2 among γ in {0.05,0.2,1,2} whose E_dev≤1.10 E_dev(task_only); if none eligible, choose minimum E_dev and mark fallback; tie smaller gamma
primary_diagnostic: Report all 12 selected gamma, tradeoff vs task-only in dev E and relative B, and B and output capture sign by seed; no success gate promoted to prospective ROC-02
secondary: raw five-arm numerical frontier and 1.10x task-only budget failures
report task loss vs dev selection optimism, exact rank and projector identities
all rank-matched nulls carried from ROC-02B, no new null p-values claimed from optimized candidates without recomputing null test
original neural model weights and train/dev case hashes verified
random_seed_rule: No new randomness in optimizer; full-batch gradients and deterministic QR
inference: Calibration exposure is prior to any ROC-02 sealed test, future randomized input interventions and nine-rank 128-null sweep still required
resource: Single CPU thread, no paid compute
provenance: Publish source and per-seed/arm receipts with exact checkpoint hashes, gamma selections and failure rows; preserve this registration.
